commits_data.title: rdp: add dissector for the egfx channel
commits_data.message:
rdp: add dissector for the egfx channel

This patch adds basic dissection for the egfx channel. It also fixes fragmentation
in the dynamic channel, and also introduces some of the decompressors involved in RDP
traffic.

commits_data.title: rdp: dissect close requests PDU in drdynvc channel
commits_data.message:
rdp: dissect close requests PDU in drdynvc channel

This patch adds the display of the corresponding channel name.

commits_data.title: rdp: set the server address in the right place
commits_data.message:
rdp: set the server address in the right place

In some cases the server address was set too late, this patch fixes that.
